typography.rules: High contrast typography. Use geometric sans for readability and strong monospace for all data, metrics, code, and flags. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid (Density, Data Correlation, Scanability).
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Rounded-sm (2px to 4px max) to maintain a sharp, technical, and brutalist hacker aesthetic. NO pill-shaped buttons unless it is a premium tier badge.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text and terminal logs. Center-align empty states and primary action dialogs.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (#0D1117) with 1px solid border (#21262D). On hover/active, the border shifts to neon green (#00FF41) or cyan (#00F0FF) with a subtle drop-shadow glow.
surface_strategies.terminal_panels: Pure black (#000000) background, no border, with a 1px top border of neon green indicating 'active connection'.

buttons.primary: Solid neon green (#00FF41) background, black text, sharp corners. For danger actions (Stop Lab), use neon red (#FF3B30).
buttons.outline: Transparent background, 1px neon border, neon text.
buttons.ghost: Transparent background, muted text, changes to neon text on hover.

surface_strategies.inputs: Terminal style. Transparent background, bottom border only (1px solid #484F58), which glows cyan on focus. Prefix with 'root@cybershield:~# ' for the flag submission input.

motion_and_interactions.status_indicators: Pulsing animation (opacity 0.4 to 1) for live server statuses.
motion_and_interactions.terminal_cursor: Blinking square block (animate-pulse) at the end of terminal logs.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fast, rigid opacity fades. No bouncy spring animations. It should feel like a lightning-fast CLI execution.
motion_and_interactions.charts: Draw-in line animation for network/CPU charts upon loading.

components.lab_catalog_card: Vertical layout. Thumbnail image on top. Monospace difficulty badge (e.g., [ HARD ]) floating top-right. Title, brief description, and a 'Deploy' button.
components.server_monitor_chart: Recharts line chart. Black background, neon green stroke for CPU, cyan stroke for RAM. Hide axes lines, show only horizontal grid lines (dashed, low opacity).
components.flag_input: Full width monospace input. Styled to look like a command line interface. Label: 'SUBMIT_FLAG'.
components.bottom_tab_navigator: Mobile-first bottom tabs. Dark background, unselected icons in muted gray (#8B949E). Selected icon glows with primary neon color (#00FF41) with a 2px top border on the active tab.

media.rules: Use the provided image URLs exactly. Do not use placeholders. If an image is missing, use a solid dark background with a monospace icon.

cyber_background_1.description: Abstract neon green data nodes on deep black. Use for Login/Auth screen background or Profile hero.

lab_thumbnail_apache.description: Glowing yellow/amber server rack. Use as thumbnail for Outdated Apache or Server configuration labs.

lab_thumbnail_sql.description: Neon red glowing database icon. Use as thumbnail for SQL Injection or database vulnerability labs.

hacker_code_screen_1.description: Black flat screen computer monitor with code. Use as a fallback for other lab thumbnails like XSS.

hacker_code_screen_2.description: Close-up colorful terminal code. Use for the Analytics dashboard hero or generic lab backgrounds.

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (for dense dashboards) or generic React Native vector icons (Feather/Ionicons) in mobile. Prefer sharp, geometric icon variants.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all neon text on black backgrounds meets 4.5:1 ratio. Avoid pure black text on neon green if the green is too dark; use very light green or dark text on bright green buttons.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, lab cards) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="submit-flag-button"').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using a dark mobile-first layout. If using React Native, map the hex colors directly to StyleSheet or NativeWind classes.
Do NOT use pure white backgrounds anywhere.
For the Terminal/Logs view, implement a ScrollView with inverted colors (pure black bg, green text, monospace font).
Use the provided image URLs for the lab catalog cards and login background.
Ensure the bottom navigation uses the active/inactive color states defined in components.bottom_tab_navigator.
The 'Start Lab' button should be highly prominent (neon green fill), while 'Stop Lab' should be neon red.
Apply the 'data-testid' attribute to all actionable UI elements.
